sql.query: SELECT m.id milestoneId,m.milestoneName,m.milestoneGroup,m.timingCategory,m.sourceType,m.displayOrder,CASE WHEN m.sourceType='contract' THEN COALESCE((SELECT CASE gc.status WHEN 'draft' THEN 'Draft' WHEN 'issued' THEN 'Issued' WHEN 'sent' THEN 'Sent' WHEN 'signed' THEN 'Signed' ELSE REPLACE(gc.status,'_',' ') END FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc WHERE gc.workflowId=w.id AND gc.tenantId=w.tenantId ORDER BY gc.modifiedDate DESC,gc.id DESC LIMIT 1),'Not created') ELSE COALESCE(selectedOption.optionName,defaultOption.optionName,'Not set') END optionName,CASE WHEN m.sourceType='contract' THEN CASE COALESCE((SELECT gc.status FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc WHERE gc.workflowId=w.id AND gc.tenantId=w.tenantId ORDER BY gc.modifiedDate DESC,gc.id DESC LIMIT 1),'') WHEN 'signed' THEN '#198754' WHEN 'issued' THEN '#0d6efd' WHEN 'sent' THEN '#0dcaf0' WHEN 'draft' THEN '#ffc107' ELSE '#6c757d' END ELSE COALESCE(selectedOption.colour,defaultOption.colour,'#6c757d') END colour,wmv.optionId,wmv.notes FROM tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_event_milestones m ON m.tenantId=w.tenantId AND m.isActive=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_workflow_milestone_values wmv ON wmv.workflowId=w.id AND wmv.milestoneId=m.id AND wmv.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_event_milestone_options selectedOption ON selectedOption.id=wmv.optionId AND selectedOption.milestoneId=m.id AND selectedOption.tenantId=m.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_event_milestone_options defaultOption ON defaultOption.milestoneId=m.id AND defaultOption.tenantId=m.tenantId AND defaultOption.isDefault=1 AND defaultOption.isActive=1 WHERE w.id=:workflowId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId ORDER BY FIELD(m.timingCategory,'before_show','during_show','after_show'),m.displayOrder,m.id
